name: southriver_web_composer
_data_comment: South River is a no-backend shell: "local" makes every composed SDK read the host-owned data/ folder (theme, team, stockists, products, about, legal) through base_sdk's server-only reader and hides base's backend-only surface. See data/README.md and base/nextjs/docs/site-data.md in RokctAI/core.
description: Active Next.js SDK list for the southriver-web shell (composed by The-Rokct-Protocol core/utils/nextjs/sdk_composer.py)
_comment: Generated at spawn by the factory's seed_composer.py from RokctAI/The-Rokct-Protocol nextjs_compose_example.json (@ 1dbe1497ea7ff41cd3ea652e0f75be922ff169a4). Registry templates are canonical: when core/utils/frappe/composer/southriver-web.json carries an 'sdks' array, every compose re-materializes this file from it, and `scripts/compose.sh refresh` re-pins every entry from the SDK repos. This committed copy is the offline record of the shell's composition floor (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9). Change the registry template first, then mirror it here.
